questions.question: What creature takes the shape of your worst fear?
questions.note: Lupin keeps one in a wardrobe for Defense class. It changes depending on who is looking at it.

questions.question: What spell turns a boggart into something funny?
questions.note: You picture the fear as ridiculous, then cast. Laughter finishes it.

questions.question: In Lupin's class, whose worst fear appears as Professor Snape?
questions.note: The ridiculous version puts Snape in Neville's grandmother's clothes, including the vulture hat.

questions.question: What picks Harry up after he loses his temper and inflates Aunt Marge?
questions.note: Emergency transport for the stranded witch or wizard. Stan Shunpike is the conductor. It jumps to side streets to avoid traffic.

questions.question: What phrase clears the Marauder's Map?
choices: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good.
questions.note: The ink fades and the parchment goes blank. The opening line is the other half of the pair.

questions.question: What does the Whomping Willow hide?
questions.answer: The tunnel to the Shrieking Shack
choices: The tunnel to the Shrieking Shack
questions.note: You press a knot on the trunk to freeze the branches. Lupin used the shack so his transformations would not reach the school.

questions.question: What broom does Sirius anonymously send Harry after the Nimbus 2000 is destroyed?
questions.note: The Whomping Willow smashes the Nimbus during a Quidditch match. The Firebolt shows up at the end of the film.

questions.question: What death omen does Professor Trelawney see in Harry's teacup?
questions.note: A giant spectral dog. Harry keeps seeing a black dog that year. It is Sirius, not an omen.

questions.question: What does Lupin give Harry to eat after a Dementor attack?
questions.note: Chocolate helps after Dementors. Lupin hands it over on the Hogwarts Express.

questions.question: What is the Dementor's Kiss?
choices: It turns you into a ghost
questions.note: The body is left alive and empty. The Ministry plans to give Sirius the Kiss if he is caught.
